Let me rewrite hasNewline to compute oldIdx/newIdx directly and compare to lastA-1/lastB-1.

For Delete:

for i := 0; i <= index; i++ {

}
// oldIdx is 1-based count; 0-based index = oldIdx-1

For Insert:

missing := newIdx == lastB && !bNewline

For Equal: both counted, compare each.

part.text:
Set up `difftool`, a dependency-free Go module that computes and displays unified diffs.

Structure:
- `go.mod` — module `difftool`, Go 1.24
- `diff/diff.go` — Myers O(ND) line diff plus `Unified`, `UnifiedContext`, `UnifiedLabels`, `Myers`; emits `@@` hunks, configurable context, and `\ No newline at end of file` markers
- `main.go` — CLI: `difftool [-U n] <old> <new>`, where `-` reads stdin; exits `1` when texts differ (useful in test scripts)
- `diff/diff_test.go` — 10 tests covering insert/delete/replace, multi-hunk grouping, zero/negative context, label handling, and no-newline markers

Verified with `gofmt -l`, `go vet ./...`, `go test ./...` (all pass), and output matches GNU `diff -u` byte-for-byte apart from timestamps.

Note: Go wasn't installed, so I installed 1.27.1 to `/tmp/opencode/go` for verification only — nothing in the repo depends on it. Files are untracked; I haven't committed anything.
